```{r}
library(gbm)
species_gbm=gbm(Species~.,
            data=iris,
            distribution="multinomial")
```

```{r}
best_iter = gbm.perf(species_gbm)
print(best_iter)
```

```{r}
preds=predict(species_gbm,iris,n.trees=25,type="response")[,,1]
yhat=colnames(preds)[max.col(preds)]
table(iris$Species,yhat)
```
